name: Logowright
tagline: Logos drawn in SVG, and the whole kit around them.
about:
Logowright is a Claude Code plugin that designs a logo as clean SVG from a short brief, sets the name in real typefaces so you choose by eye, and exports the whole brand kit around it from one file.

The mark is a drafting compass seen from its top: its arms and legs come down to two points and make a W, with the north star in front, for drawing and finding your way with one instrument.
construction: On a 256 grid: arms 20 wide and legs, hinge ring and handle 10 wide (the one secondary weight), the legs fixed into the arms' feet; a four-point star of radius 40 on the centre line, set 6 clear of the compass.

colors.name: Midnight

colors.name: North Star
colors.usage: The star, and one highlight per layout; never body text.
